comments:
Wexlo is a hosted service. There is no plugin and nothing to install, which
is why the plugin and operating system fields are left blank. It runs in any
modern browser.

Scope in practice: the free scan covers one page and asks for an email
address. A paid scan covers all reachable pages up to one hundred, selected
as a spread sample from the sitemap.

To be explicit about what the tool does not do: it evaluates and reports. It
does not modify, inject into or overlay the site being evaluated. Criteria
that cannot be decided automatically are reported as needing human review
instead of being scored as passed.

Our own accessibility statement is at https://wexlo.eu/accessibility. Happy
to correct or update this entry at any time.
features: Wexlo covers the evaluation workflow end to end: scan a website against WCAG 2.1 AA, map each finding to its criterion, page and element, get a repair route per finding, generate a draft accessibility statement, and re-measure to track progress in one dossier. Criteria needing human judgement are marked, not scored.
title: Wexlo
